stem: 7. If A = {a, {a, b}}, write all the subsets of A.

entries.question: 7. If A = {a, {a, b}}, write all the subsets of A.
steps: Identify the two distinct elements of A: the letter a and the set {a, b}; the latter is one element, not two separate elements of A.
A set with two elements has 2² = 4 subsets: the empty set, each singleton, and the whole set.
The singleton containing the set {a, b} is {{a, b}}; distinguish it from {a, b}, which is itself an element of A.
entries.mathCheck: Represent elements as distinct tokens α=a and β={a,b}; all 2^2 subsets enumerated.
